تمتنعون (form VIII)
# تَمْتَنِعُونَ (tamtaniʕūna) /tam.ta.ni.ʕuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِمْتَنَعَ (imtanaʕa)
# تُمْتَنَعُونَ (tumtanaʕūna) /tum.ta.na.ʕuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِمْتَنَعَ (imtanaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
